subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw CLI subprocess startup ~25s on idle macOS; worker-tick fan-out under launchd compounds to 5+ min ticks

question: Should this tracker define a core startup-performance guarantee for plugin CLI commands, or should it be split so core owns only verified shared loader overhead while the recipes and kitchen plugins own worker fan-out and cache behavior?
rationale: The symptoms cross core and plugin ownership boundaries, and profiling has not yet shown which layer dominates enough to select a permanent implementation direction safely.

options.title: Split by owner
options.body: Profile current builds, retain verified shared loader regressions in core, and route worker scheduling and cache resilience to the owning plugins.

options.title: Own end-to-end in core
options.body: Define a core startup budget for plugin commands and add generic runtime infrastructure needed to keep high-fan-out invocations within that budget.

options.title: Require plugin-only remediation
options.body: Direct the remaining work to the external plugins unless a current core-only command reproduces comparable startup latency.

recommendation.title: Split by owner
recommendation.body: Profile current builds, retain verified shared loader regressions in core, and route worker scheduling and cache resilience to the owning plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only strongly evidenced current-history contributor directly connected to the relevant timeout and subprocess behavior, though broader product ownership remains uncertain.
